permit.applies: The performer or the engaging organisation applies to the Director of Immigration Services online through the eFNS portal (Form 32 stamped by the organisation, with a cover letter); on approval an invoice is generated, to be paid within 30 days or the approval lapses.
permit.first: A short-term assignment in Kenya, such as a performance, and the engaging organisation's registration certificate and any clearance letter from the relevant institutions.
permit.eligibility: Non-Kenyans wanting to carry out short term business assignments like assembling machinery, maintenance or performance whether paid or unpaid must obtain a Kenya Special Pass

sources.title: Music in Africa, Kenya: Work/Entry Permits (reproducing the Department of Immigration Services' notice)
sources.said: Non-Kenyans wanting to carry out short term business assignments like assembling machinery, maintenance or performance whether paid or unpaid must obtain a Kenya Special Pass from The Director of Immigration Services.

sources.title: Clyde & Co, Review of charges and fees with respect to immigration application in Kenya (November 2023) (Gazette Notice No. 15493 of 14 November 2023, Kenya Gazette)
sources.said: Special Pass, which is issued to a foreigner who wishes to work in Kenya for a short duration of time not exceeding a maximum of six (6) months. … Special Pass (issuance fees) … KES 15,000 per month

sources.title: Department of Immigration Services, eFNS information pack: Application for a Special Pass
sources.said: This document is issued under regulation 34 of the Kenya Citizenship and Immigration Regulations, 2012 to person(s) who wishes to enter Kenya or remain in Kenya for:- … A limited period for the purpose of applying a review of a decision denying a permit … Applying for a permit or pass … Temporarily conducting any business, trade or profession … A dully filled and signed Form 32 - Special Pass online application form (Stamped by Institution). … Detailed and Signed Cover letter addressed to the Director of Immigration Services from the applicant/organization … After your application is approved, an invoice will be generated … Failure to pay for the Special Pass within thirty (30) days from the date of notification will render the approval null and void under section 56 of the Immigration Regulation 2012.

sources.title: Department of Immigration Services, Issuance of Special Passes checklist
sources.said: Application form 32 duly filled, signed and stamped by organization

note: A performer on a short assignment, paid or unpaid, takes the Special Pass (the Department's notice as Music in Africa reproduces it); work beyond six months takes a work permit class. The fee could not be fixed: Clyde & Co reads the Cabinet Secretary's Gazette Notice No. 15493 of 14 November 2023 as proposing KES 15,000 a month from 1 January 2024, while Cliffe Dekker Hofmeyr's March 2024 alert (403 to this client, seen only as a search snippet) reports KES 5,000 processing plus USD 200 issuance from 1 March 2024; immigration.go.ke fails certificate verification here, so neither is confirmed. The East African Community's arrangements aren't modelled apart. Retry 2026-11-01: who applies and what comes first now rest on the Department of Immigration Services' own eFNS information pack and checklist (fns.immigration.go.ke), which name no fee (the invoice comes after approval) and no decision time.
